name: Mauna Lani Resort, Auberge Collection
insider_take: This legendary oceanfront sanctuary sits on ancient Hawaiian grounds where royalty once walked, offering an authentic connection to the islands' spiritual heritage.
whats_special: Mauna Lani Resort is built on sacred Hawaiian land featuring ancient fishponds that still operate today, plus petroglyphs dating back 3,000 years. The resort's name means "mountain reaching heaven" in Hawaiian, and it's positioned on the prestigious Kohala Coast where volcanic black lava meets pristine white sand beaches.
pro_tip: Take the complimentary cultural walk to see the Kal?huipua'a Historic Trail with its ancient petroglyphs and fishponds - it's one of the most significant archaeological sites in Hawaii, yet many guests never discover it.
dont_miss: The nightly manta ray viewing at nearby beaches where these gentle giants with 14-foot wingspans come to feed, and snorkeling at 49 Black Sand Beach, a hidden gem just minutes away that locals consider one of Big Island's best-kept secrets.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location on pristine Mauna Lani Bay
Luxurious spa treatments with traditional Hawaiian healing practices
Multiple dining venues featuring locally-sourced Hawaiian cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive resort status
Remote Big Island location requires additional travel planning
